description: List currently TRIGGERED (open, unacknowledged) incidents for a team — the active fire-fighting queue. Spike: GET /incidents/triggered (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

name: spike_list_triggered_incidents
title: List triggered incidents
